title: Help text for `cam claude` still shows a dated example `--model claude-opus-4-5…
description:
Help text for `cam claude` still shows a dated example `--model claude-opus-4-5`. Out of scope for this PRD (US-001 scoped to DEFAULTS/MODEL_OPTIONS/project.toml), but a dated id in an example is exactly the drift ADR-0034 targets; consider aliasing it to `--model opus` in a follow-up.

Source: cam/issue-287
Review round: 1
Location: src/commands/claude.ts:40

suggestion-fingerprint: b7fd02799e58

acceptanceCriteria: The `cam claude` help/usage text (claude.ts:40) no longer contains a dated concrete model id (e.g. claude-opus-4-5) in its example.
The example uses a stable alias (--model opus) that resolves via the existing MODEL_OPTIONS alias map.
The alias shown is verified to be a real accepted value for --model (not just cosmetic text).
spec.scope: Edit the example in the cam claude help text (claude.ts:40) to use --model opus instead of the dated --model claude-opus-4-5. Help-text-only change; do not alter model resolution logic or DEFAULTS/MODEL_OPTIONS.
gotchas: Confirm 'opus' is a valid alias in MODEL_OPTIONS before using it in the example; if the alias differs, use the actual stable alias.
This is the exact drift ADR-0034 targets (dated model ids in surfaced text).
